# systeam_integration_key (Resource)

Manages an inbound-events integration key. External systems (Alertmanager, Grafana, Prometheus, PagerDuty-format senders) authenticate with this key to raise incidents that route to an escalation policy.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `escalation_policy_id` (Number) The escalation policy that inbound events on this key are routed to.
- `name` (String) A human-readable name for the key.
- `organization_id` (Number) The ID of the organization this key belongs to.

### Optional

- `grouping_type` (String) How incoming alerts are grouped into incidents: none, time_window, service, or intelligent.
- `grouping_window_seconds` (Number) The grouping window in seconds (used when grouping_type is not 'none').

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) The unique identifier of the integration key.
- `is_active` (Boolean) Whether the key is active (revoked keys are inactive).
- `token` (String, Sensitive) The full secret routing key. Returned ONLY at creation; put it in your Alertmanager/Grafana webhook URL. It is not readable afterwards, so it is preserved in state from the create.
- `token_prefix` (String) The non-secret prefix of the key, shown in the UI to identify it.
